meta.titulo: Porsche 911 2.2 T Targa Tangerine · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 911 2.2 T Targa in Tangerine color, manual transmission of 5 speeds and restoration of body, engine, gearbox, brakes and interior. Price: 94.000 €.

intro.titulo:
An essential
classic from the first 911,
completely restored.
parrafos: This Porsche 911 2.2 T Targa brings together rear engine architecture, manual transmission and a body Targa that allows you to enjoy open driving without give up the model's characteristic silhouette. Produced in January 1971, it is equipped with a flat-six engine with 2,2 liters and manual gearbox with 5 speeds.
The body and paint were completely restored in 2014, the engine and gearbox in 2015, and the brake system in 2021. The interior, in black, is in very good condition.
intro.cita: A classic configuration of the first 911: body Tangerine, Targa roof, five speeds and mechanics that demand participation. Restored in its main sections and fully functional.

fotos.caption: Complete profile · Targa bow and PORSCHE stripe
Direct front · Chrome and round headlight

parrafos: The engine flat-six butt 2,2 liters It retains the air-cooled architecture that defines the technical identity of the 911. The box five speed manual, identified as type 911/01 / 7115778 / 901, reinforces the analog character of the unit.
The engine and gearbox were restored in 2015 and, according to available information, are in good working order. The brake system was restored most recently, in 2021.
The unit incorporates from the factory front and rear stabilizers (code 405), which reinforce the control of the body in a light and compact car.

items: Fidelity to the original of the first 911

exterior.texto: The color Tangerine 2310 visually defines this unit and reinforces its period character. The red-orange hue establishes a strong contrast with the black roof panel, the arc Targa metal, chrome moldings and black side stripe with inscription PORSCHE. The restoration of body and painting of 2014 allows you to clearly appreciate the compact surfaces and visual lightness of the early 911.

fotos.caption: Front detail · Round headlight and chrome

interior.editorial: The black interior maintains the functional approach of the first 911. The horizontal dashboard, five-dial dial, thin-rim steering wheel and long manual lever place all essential controls around the driver. According to the information provided, the interior was restored and is in perfect condition.

hitos.cuerpo: The unit received a comprehensive intervention in the exterior section, including body and painting in color Tangerine, code 2310.

hitos.titulo: Restoration of the engine and gearbox
hitos.cuerpo: The main mechanics were restored the year after the body. According to the information provided, its current operation is correct. 5 speed manual gearbox, type 911/01.
The most recent intervention documented corresponds to the braking assembly. The unit is currently located in a stage 2 of conservation, with some specific points that could be improved.

opinion.bio: More than 25 years of experience with collectible Porsche. He has supervised hundreds of special vehicle purchase and sale operations, with special focus on the brand's founding classics.
opinion.intro: "The 2.2 T Targa is the 911 in its most direct form: without filters, without concessions, with the roof open."
parrafos: The 911 2.2 T represents one of the most essential interpretations of the classic 911. Without the sophistication of the S versions, it offers mechanics that require participation and a cabin built around the fundamental controls: steering wheel, lever and five clocks. Nothing else.

The body Targa adds a particular dimension to the experience. The removable roof panel allows the passenger compartment to be opened, while the rear arch maintains an immediately recognizable image and its own visual structure within the 911 range.

The Tangerine color reinforces the period character of the unit and makes the original shapes of the body, the chrome and the contrast with the black roof, the Targa arch and the side stripe especially visible.

This unit arrives with a clear and documented restoration chronology: body in 2014, engine and gearbox in 2015, and brakes in 2021. An honest stage 2, with room for improvement, not a competitive exercise.

Period rear flat-six mechanics, without filters
contras: Unit in stage 2, with some specific points of improvement
